name: TimedLineScrollView
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play auto-scrolling, timeline-synced multi-line text — the "current line glides into view and lights up while the rest dim" look popularized by synced song-lyrics displays in music apps, equally useful for a teleprompter script, a subtitle track, or any multi-line text that should auto-advance alongside audio/video/a timeline instead of the viewer manually scrolling.  Distinct from Toolkit.TMPEffects.TMPTimedHighlighter (the SAME timeline-driven idea, different addressing): that one highlights WORDS within one block of text; this one advances between whole LINES, each its own TMP_Text instance, auto-scrolling the container to keep the current one centered — a different enough data model and rendering technique to warrant its own component.

src_serialized.name: linePrefab
src_serialized.tooltip: Template cloned once per line. Needs a TMP_Text component.

src_serialized.name: lines
src_serialized.tooltip: One entry per line, in ascending startTime order. Populate via the Inspector, SetLines(), SetLinesEvenlySpread(), or LoadLinesFromJson().

src_serialized.name: activeFontScale
src_serialized.tooltip: The active (current) line's font size multiplies by this — 1 disables the size pop entirely.

src_serialized.name: audioSource
src_serialized.tooltip: Optional — if assigned, playback time is read from this automatically every frame instead of needing manual SetPlaybackTime() calls.

src_members.name: SetLines
src_members.comment: Replaces the whole line list and rebuilds the displayed line instances — e.g. loading a new song's lyrics or a new script.

src_members.sig: public void SetLinesEvenlySpread(IEnumerable<string> lineTexts, float totalDuration)
src_members.name: SetLinesEvenlySpread
src_members.comment: Quick-start helper for when you don't have real per-line timestamps yet — spreads the given lines evenly across totalDuration. Replace with SetLines()/LoadLinesFromJson() once you have real timing data (e.g. from a synced-lyrics file).

src_members.name: LoadLinesFromJson
src_members.comment: Accepts either {"lines":[{"text":"...","startTime":0}, ...]} or a bare [...] array (JsonUtility can't parse a top-level array directly, so a bare array is auto-wrapped) — same convention as TMPTimedHighlighter.LoadTimingsFromJson.

src_members.name: GetLineIndexAtTime
src_members.comment: Public, pure logic (no TMP dependency) — mirrors TMPTimedHighlighter.GetWordIndexAtTime for the same reason: fully verifiable without needing a real, laid-out TMP font.
